name: Peroneal Tendon Tear
definition: Partial or complete tear of the peroneus brevis and/or longus tendon, usually causing lateral ankle pain, weakness and sometimes instability.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound or MRI defines tendon tear, split lesion and associated retinacular injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent symptomatic tears or instability may require surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha/Pada-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or complete tear of the peroneus brevis and/or longus tendon, usually causing lateral ankle pain, weakness and sometimes instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
